title: Redact credentials from tracking URI in mlflow-artifacts scheme error
answers: database password appears in MLflow server logs when serving artifacts
mlflow-artifacts tracking URI error leaks credentials in logs
tracing exporter warning prints postgres password in cleartext
how do I keep tracking URI secrets out of error messages
body:
Symptom: With `--serve-artifacts` and a credentialed backend store URI (e.g. postgresql://user:password@host/db), the tracing exporter logs a WARNING that exposes the database password in cleartext.
Root cause: mlflow/store/artifact/mlflow_artifacts_repo.py:_validate_uri_scheme interpolated the full `parsed_uri.geturl()` (userinfo, query, params, fragment included) into the MlflowException message, and callers log that message.
Fix pattern: Before formatting any tracking URI into an error or log string, strip userinfo (`netloc.rpartition("@")`) and drop `params`, `query`, `fragment` via `_replace(...)`, keeping scheme, host, port and path so the message stays actionable.
Constraints: Query strings can carry secrets too (e.g. `?password=` or `odbc_connect=...PWD=...`), so redacting userinfo alone is not enough. URIs without credentials are otherwise unchanged. The scheme check itself is unchanged.
applies: Any error or log message in mlflow-artifacts / tracking URI handling that formats a tracking or store URI; does not cover other message sites that are not touched by this change.
says: Backend database passwords appear in cleartext inside server error logs during artifact proxying.
Storage connection warnings expose sensitive database credentials and passwords in application server logs.
Sanitize artifact storage error messages so database passwords are never printed in logs.
Tracing exporter warnings leak backend storage access keys and database passwords to logs.
Prevent sensitive database login credentials from being exposed in artifact server diagnostic messages.
search: Tracking and store URIs formatted into error or log messages must redact credentials in mlflow/store/artifact/mlflow_artifacts_repo.py:_validate_uri_scheme. The redaction strips userinfo via netloc.rpartition('@') and removes query, params, and fragment via _replace(...), keeping scheme, host, port, and path. This applies to any error or log message in mlflow-artifacts or tracking URI handling to prevent cleartext password leakage when running with --serve-artifacts and credentialed backend store URIs.
